newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 20.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 58.35 points at 7,777.06, standing just below its record closing high of 7,782.04 set on June 13.

* The government islikely to postpone the announcement of the planned economic deregulation until the end of July as the ministers involved in the drafting of the package needed more time to discuss the policy, Harian Ekonomi Neraca daily reported. The package had previously been expected to be announced later this month.

* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 2.34 points, or 0.33 percent, at 708.45 points in profit-taking, with bank stocks among the most active as a World Bank report on Indonesia was seen having little impact on the sector, brokers and analysts said.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,430.75/31.25 at 0150 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.50/31.50.
* Cigarette maker Gudang Garam on reports it did not have plans to raise its retail pricesthis year.
* Ceramics maker Keramik Indonesia Asosiasi after announcement of a rights issue to raise 127.5 billion rupiah.
* Pulp and rayon manufacturer Indorayon after an announcement that its subsidiary has completed acquisition of a Finland-based viscose fibers manufacturer.
* BDNI following strong gains on Wednesday on market talk that the bank was likely to acquire a privately-owned bank.

* Textile firm Roda Vivatex on market talk of a possible take-over and that the firm was likely to announce a rights issue. The firm has denied the rumours. Roda has made modest gains in active trading in the past several days due to the rumours.
